ideas.title: Investigation into Minneapolis shooting
ideas.description: An investigation into the Minneapolis shooting, including the use of force by federal agents and potential misconduct.
ideas.angle: Use of force, misconduct, and accountability
questions: What was the justification for the use of force?
What actions will be taken to ensure accountability?
ideas.insight: This story would investigate the Minneapolis shooting and potential misconduct by federal agents, and could shed light on issues of accountability and use of force.
